verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair axis for a note-taking app, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The nearby privacy features are different capabilities and earn no credit here: end-to-end encryption of note contents, bring-your-own AI API key, and excluding private notes from AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
